note: Routing algorithm summary (approval-workflow.md §5.3): A_route = abs(Amount) for VariationOrder, or G_k (gross certified value of the period) for PaymentCertificate. Select the project-specific active policy for the DocumentType, else the tenant-wide active policy; select all rules where MinAmount <= A_route < MaxAmount (or MaxAmount IS NULL); order by StepNo to form the chain. Apply cumulative-VO escalation (VO only) if (sum(approved VO) + Amount) / ContractValue * 100 > CumulativeVoEscalationPct, appending CumulativeVoEscalationRole as a final step if not already present. Fail closed: an empty chain blocks submission with ApprovalPolicyGap (422) - never auto-approve.
